name: GothHouse
source: You play as a goth futa who is also an elf and partly a crow. Hunted by bad memories and being afraid of overusing her underworld power Darci Nightshade is trying to find her place in the "Avalonian society".
translation: 你扮演一个哥特富塔，他也是一个精灵，一半是乌鸦。被不好的记忆所困扰，并害怕过度使用她的黑社会力量，达西·夜影试图在“阿瓦隆社会”中找到自己的位置。
